intro: Rhinag is an afflicted jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe, sheltering among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened by the harsh venom of the region's scorpids, he relies entirely on passing travelers to secure him a timely remedy.

p: While traversing the arid terrain of Durotar, Rhinag fell victim to the vicious sting of a local Venomtail Scorpid. Overwhelmed by the potent poison, he took shelter among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened and isolated, his survival hinges on anyone who happens by with the resolve to procure a venomtail antidote before the toxins take their final toll.
